theme: Professional Light Mode AND Technical Dark Mode (Architectural / Engineered, Precise, Minimal)

visual_enhancers.borders_dividers: Hairline 1px borders (border-border), no rounded-xl/2xl. Max border-radius of 4px (rounded-sm) for a sharp, technical look.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use 1px borders instead of box-shadows. Elevated states (like dropdowns) use subtle shadow-sm.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: 150-250ms smooth transitions (transition-all duration-200 ease-out). No flashy bounce animations.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Dense technical grids, 4px/8px baseline (gap-2, gap-4). Efficient use of space for tables and property values.
visual_enhancers.icons: lucide-react, 16px to 20px sizes, stroke-width 1.5 for a fine, drafted look.

layouts.dashboard: Modular, F-pattern. Top KPIs, high-density tables for recent projects. Command palette on CMD/CTRL+K.
layouts.workspace: 3-column layout: Left navigation (Project/Measure/Design/QA), Center dense workspace (label-value pairs, tables), Right context/Intelligence panel (Checks, scores, status).
layouts.measure_design: Compact technical tables (Layer, Material, Thickness, U-value). Big readout for calculated vs target U-values.
layouts.document_preview: Professionally typeset, architectural document vibe. Elegant numbering, technical drawing aesthetics.

components.technical_tables: Compact, border-collapse, font-mono for values, right-aligned numbers.
components.status_chips: Small, uppercase, font-medium, padding x-2 y-0.5, specific semantic background colors with high contrast text.
components.field_value_pairs: Flex row, label on left (text-muted-foreground), value on right (font-medium or font-mono).
components.readiness_meters: Slim progress bars (h-1), color-coded by completeness and QA pass/fail.
components.command_palette: CMD/CTRL+K shortcut, floating modal, blur backdrop, fast keyboard navigation.

blueprint_graphics.description: Architectural blueprint of a building plan

insulation_photo.description: Building under construction with blue insulating wrap

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize technical accuracy and tabular presentation.
Avoid oversized padding. Use dense padding (p-2, p-3) for structural elements.
Use JetBrains Mono or a similar monospace font for all U-values, thicknesses, and technical specs.
Implement the 3-column layout strictly for the main workspace.
Use semantic colors exactly as specified for status markers (Pass, Warn, Critical, Draft).
Ensure dark mode is intentionally designed with #0A0A0A backgrounds and distinct borders, not just a color inversion.
Implement a command palette triggered by CMD/K.
Use HTML/Tailwind for layouts, and heavily customized Shadcn components for interactive bits.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive and key informational elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use random gradients or excessive rounded corners.
Avoid 'AI startup' clichés; this is a serious engineering tool.
Use clear visual hierarchy: Project > Section > Subsection > Component > Field > Supporting Info.
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays.
